## Checklist for offers

- [ ] One file per offer in `content/offers`, named in lowercase kebab-case
- [ ] The offer is available to people studying in Finland
- [ ] `url` goes to the provider's own page, with no affiliate or tracking parameters
- [ ] Finnish and English texts are both filled in
- [ ] I checked the details on the provider's page today and set `lastVerified`
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
